name: Philips Hue
author: Control It Team
subtitle: Smart Lighting & Studio Tally Illumination
descriptionText: Control smart bulbs, light strips, color scenes, brightness, and tally alerts via local Philips Hue Bridge API.

setupFields.label: Hue Bridge IP
setupFields.helpText: Enter IP address of your Philips Hue Bridge.

setupFields.label: Hue API App Key / Username
setupFields.helpText: Obtained by pairing with the bridge button.

variables.name: Group 1 On State
variables.descriptionText: Whether group 1 lights are turned on

actions.title: Hue: Tally Red (On Air)
actions.subtitle: Turn studio light solid RED
actions.descriptionText: Sets target light to bright red indicating active recording/broadcast.

actions.title: Hue: Tally Green (Standby)
actions.subtitle: Turn studio light solid GREEN
actions.descriptionText: Sets target light to green indicating standby / ready.

actions.title: Hue: Get Light State
actions.subtitle: Query bulb on/off & brightness
actions.descriptionText: Fetches current on/off and brightness status for a Philips Hue light.
